summary: One coherent behavior: give the mid bands their section 14.3 visual identity (water color, visibility, particle profile, light attenuation, background silhouettes, debris, currents) expressed through the existing src/render/ pipeline and the shared WI-07 band-data seam, so the section 14.1 hybrid keeps reading at 1080p with light falling off steadily between the surface/coast pair and the deep pair. The section 15 flashlight behavior (no pure-black screens, biological sources reveal geometry from behind) and the critical-path scene dressing of the mid bands are part of dressing those same bands, not separately shippable features; the section 16 scale-reveal zoom deliverable is strictly conditional (any select colossal encounter staged in the mid bands, camera-only, no encounter re-authoring, ST-04 owns the encounters) and is bounded by the story's per-band camera-polish assignment, which places the colossal-encounter zoom with the deep bands (WI-06c). Two named changed responsibilities (rendering and materials, world content data), within the leaf limit. Evidence is focused: per-mid-band 1080p in-motion browser inspection with recorded observations and screenshots, a Node test asserting each mid band differs from its adjacent bands in at least two identity factors against the existing WI-07 baseline data, green headless suite/build, and section 34 performance spot-checks; no open-ended defect fixing. AC-art-palettes is carried verbatim with the cross-band contrast part explicitly deferred to named final proof owner WI-06d, keeping union coverage of the parent criteria. depends_on [] is correct: WI-06a/b/c run in parallel under the story's [ST-04, ST-05] dependencies, and the adjacency test compares against already-registered baseline band data. The boundary with WI-06d is stated and coherent (no obvious debug geometry in the mid-band critical-path areas here; all critical-path areas plus the section 48 juice list there), and the non-goals (no audio, no juice, no map/a11y, no gameplay rules, no balance tuning, no encounter re-authoring, spoiler rules for evidence) keep the scope honest. Handoff (ST-06/plan.md, request sections 1.1/14/15/16/34, the band data seam in understanding.md, src/render/ plus world data, dress-don't-redesign baseline) lets a fresh implementer proceed without reconstructing the project.
